name: h2a-vscode-extension
displayName: SAP Hybris to Salesforce Apex Migrator
description: Automated migration pipeline for translating Hybris slices to governor-limit-aware Salesforce Apex.
author: Vikas

h2aMigrator.pipelinePath.description: Absolute path to the central h2a-mvp directory. If left empty, searches for h2a-mvp folder in active workspace.

h2aMigrator.pythonPath.description: Absolute path to the Python environment executable (e.g. .venv/bin/python). If left empty, searches inside pipeline directory.

enumDescriptions: Agentic (recommended) — Planner + Builder + Critic + Verifier over a shared blackboard, with RAG grounding. Richest output; more LLM calls.
Linear — the deterministic pipeline (fewer LLM calls, lower cost).
h2aMigrator.engine.description: Which migration engine to run. Both produce the same SFDX output shape; agentic adds planning (what-not-to-migrate), adversarial review, and RAG grounding.

enumDescriptions: Anthropic Claude — best quality (needs Anthropic API key)
OpenRouter — free/cheap models for dev/testing (needs OpenRouter API key)
Mock — keyless deterministic stub (no key; for testing the pipeline)
h2aMigrator.provider.description: LLM provider. Same pipeline and prompts for all — only the model changes.

h2aMigrator.anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...). Used when provider = anthropic. If empty, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the environment / h2a-mvp/.env is used.

h2aMigrator.openrouterApiKey.description: OpenRouter API key (sk-or-...). Used when provider = openrouter. If empty, OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment / h2a-mvp/.env is used.

h2aMigrator.incrementalMode.description: Enable delta (incremental) migrations. Skip compiling domains whose source Java files are unchanged.

h2aMigrator.customModel.description: Override the model for the active provider (e.g. claude-sonnet-5 for Anthropic, or meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free for OpenRouter).

h2aMigrator.verifyDeploy.description: Verify by deploying to Salesforce. After generating, run a validate-only (check-only) deploy against your default Salesforce org and self-heal real compiler/coverage errors. Requires the Salesforce CLI (sf) installed and a default org set: 'sf org login web' then 'sf config set target-org <alias>'. Nothing is written to the org.
